_note: Programme decisions the site applies on top of Sessionize at every sync. `withdrawn` drops a talk; a speaker left with no talks drops off the site too. A move puts `session` into the time and room of `slotOf`, read from Sessionize. A shift retimes `session` in its own room from `from` to `to`, keeping its length; the sync stops if Sessionize no longer has it at `from`. When Sessionize itself reflects a decision, the sync reports the entry as stale: delete it then.
